decks.notes: The main concept of this Bazaar Aggro deck is to utilize the powerful graveyard interactions of cards like Bloodghast, Vengevine, and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures. The deck also aims to take advantage of the Bazaar of Baghdad land to fill the graveyard with key creatures and spells, while also including disruptive elements like Force of Vigor and Deathrite Shaman to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck focuses on speed, graveyard synergy, and disruption to secure victories in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, card draw, and powerful tutors to control the game, disrupt the opponent's strategies, and find win conditions like Bolas's Citadel, Urza, Lord High Artificer, and Time Vault. It also includes powerful artifact mana like Black Lotus and the Moxen to ramp into these threats quickly. Additionally, cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher provide additional disruption and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and disruptive spells to maintain control of the game while applying pressure to the opponent. By combining aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Noble Hierarch with disruptive elements such as Force of Will and Flusterstorm, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and win through combat damage quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk provide additional card advantage and tempo advantage to further solidify the deck's dominance in the match.

This deck focuses on utilizing hatebears and aggressive creatures to disrupt opponent's strategies while applying pressure on the board. With cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, the deck aims to slow down opponents by taxing their spells. Stoneforge Mystic and equipment like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte provide additional threats and ways to control the board. The deck also includes hate cards like Force of Vigor to deal with problematic artifacts and enchantments. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt opponents and overwhelm them with efficient creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and disrupting opponents with sphere effects while using artifacts to control the board. It uses powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim to generate advantage and lock opponents out of the game. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a high density of artifacts and disrupt their game plan by taxing their resources. It also has a strong land destruction package to slow down opposing strategies and ensure its own pieces can take control of the game.

The deck is focused on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly. It includes a variety of cantrips, tutors, and protection spells to help find and protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells and hand disruption to control the game until the combo can be assembled. The mana base is designed to support the deck's demanding color requirements and maximize consistency. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently and consistently combo off and win the game.

The deck is centered around quickly filling the graveyard with cards by utilizing cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp. It then utilizes the Dredge mechanic to bring cards back from the graveyard, triggering effects like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam to quickly swarm the board with creatures. The deck also runs cards like Creeping Chill for direct damage and Force of Will for protection. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless combo strategy fueled by graveyard recursion and explosive creature plays.

The focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently through powerful artifact ramp like Black Lotus and Moxen, along with rituals like Dark Ritual. Using cards like Tendrils of Agony and Mind's Desire, the player can storm off and cast multiple spells in a single turn to win the game. The deck also includes various tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key combo pieces, while also including disruption like Duress and Defense Grid to protect the combo.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly by deck manipulation and card draw. It uses powerful tutors and draw spells to find and set up the combo quickly, while also incorporating strong disruption in the form of counterspells to protect the combo. The deck aims to win the game in a single turn, often by chaining multiple spells together to ensure victory. The inclusion of cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Black Lotus provide additional power and consistency to the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive artifacts to disrupt the opponent's game plan and take control of the board. It utilizes cards like Foundry Inspector and Stonecoil Serpent to pressure the opponent, while also using disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Sphere of Resistance to slow down the opponent's spells. The deck's main goal is to overwhelm the opponent with its artifact creatures and disruptive spells, while also utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge to generate card advantage and maintain tempo on the board.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly bring out aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Vengevine by utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier to fill the graveyard. Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Deathrite Shaman provide additional graveyard synergies, while Hollow One acts as a powerful early threat. Force of Vigor helps to deal with opposing threats, and Once Upon a Time helps find key pieces of the deck. The inclusion of mana acceleration through Black Lotus and Moxen allows for explosive starts, putting pressure on the opponent.

This Vintage deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and disrupting the opponent's game plan. By utilizing powerful mana accelerants like Mox Jet and Black Lotus, along with efficient removal like Abrupt Decay and Assassin's Trophy, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game. Key threats like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Dark Confidant provide consistent pressure, while cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor disrupt the opponent's artifacts and enchantments. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent while deploying aggressive threats to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for repeated value from the graveyard, while cards like Snapcaster Mage and Dreadhorde Arcanist provide additional recursion and utility. The mana base is built to support a variety of colors and maximize consistency, with a mix of cantrips and disruption to keep the deck running smoothly.

The deck focuses on using powerful spells and disruptive creatures to control the game, while also utilizing the Landstill strategy of playing Standstill and holding lands in hand to draw cards and generate card advantage. The deck includes powerful cards like Force of Will and Wrenn and Six to disrupt opponents, alongside control elements like Counter magic and disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can establish a dominant position and win the game.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and pressure with efficient creatures and equipment while disrupting opponent's plans with countermagic and card advantage spells. The deck aims to control the game tempo, disrupting opponent's plays and applying constant pressure to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Stoneforge Mystic allows for explosive plays and card advantage, while cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher can shut down opponent's card draw capabilities.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive strategy that utilizes the Bazaar of Baghdad to discard cards and fill the graveyard with key creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One. It also has a strong control element with counterspells like Force of Will and disruption cards like Mindbreak Trap. The deck is designed to be able to quickly put pressure on the opponent while also being able to disrupt their game plan, making it a versatile and powerful deck in Vintage 1 vs 1 format.
